description: Show one request on Priors' line board: the line the agent's owner asks, the agent's Priors record, every offer standing on it (the root, its owner, the amount, the premium, until when), and once the agent's owner has accepted one, its consent (the pool's own, for that one root, with the agent's nonce and a deadline) and the exact vouchWithConsent call the root's owner sends from its own wallet: target, function and calldata, checked here against the pool, the offer and the consent. This server signs and sends nothing. Read-only.

request_id.description: The request's id (its EIP-712 hash): 0x and 64 hex characters, as find_line_requests gives it.

name: line_request
title: One line request: its offers and the call that backs it
